checklist_items.reason: Only source selection and draft preservation branches asserted in this case.
checklist_items.12.1: Opened from the page Add control as the only dialog. The role is dialog, the accessible name is the drawer title, the component is ant-drawer-content, and the first step is the community repository browser. The custom import dialog count is 0
checklist_items.12.3: Default focus is the drawer panel. Tab and Shift+Tab each cycle the drawer controls. The drawer is aria-modal, so one focus-trap sentinel stays inside the trap and focus does not reach the page
checklist_items.1.1: On first open the community add drawer shows both configured repository buttons. The other-repository textbox is empty, is a text input, is not required, and has no maximum length. Its placeholder gives the example vllm/vllm-openai. The browse control stays disabled while that textbox is empty. The tag search textbox is absent. The image-archive URL textbox is empty and its placeholder is https://containerimages.example/runner.tar. Archive size and the references inside the archive are absent. Series name is an empty textbox, not required, with no maximum length. Image reference is an empty required textbox. Engine version is an empty textbox and is not required. Framework version is an empty required textbox. The only selected value is multi. The rolling-tag switch is visible, unchecked, and not required. There is no spinbutton and there are six textboxes. Reading the drawer sends no import POST. The later import POST sends engine sglang, framework cuda, engine version 4.5.6 from the selected tag, framework version 12.8, architecture multi, rolling tag false, and an empty registry source list. The independent GET stores those same fields.
checklist_items.1.8: Opening the saved series and expanding its version shows the image reference with one copy control. Filling every optional field, series name community-full, engine version 9.9.9, architecture amd64, the rolling tag on, and registry source https://containerimages.example/full.tar, with the required image reference registry.example/team/full:v9.9.9, engine vllm, framework cuda, and framework version 12.8, submits one POST to /api/v1/images/import. The body carries that series name and those version fields, source community, rolling tag true, and that one registry source. The 200 response is one series named community-full, purpose inference, enabled, with no nodes present. The independent GET keeps engine version 9.9.9, architecture amd64, rolling tag true, framework version 12.8, and that registry source. The list shows the series and opening it shows the saved reference. After reload the detail matches that GET. A separate create that leaves series name, engine version, the rolling tag, and registry sources untouched stores the backend defaults: derived name team/minimum, inferred engine version 1.2.3, architecture multi, rolling tag false, purpose inference, enabled true, and no registry sources. Both series are catalog metadata with no agent and no workload.
checklist_items.1.7: The images overview shows five statistics. Filling only the required image reference, engine, framework, and framework version, and leaving series name, engine version, and the rolling tag untouched, submits one POST to /api/v1/images/import. The body names no series, sends engine vllm, framework cuda, source community, an empty engine version, framework version 12.8, arch multi, image reference registry.example/team/minimum:v1.2.3, rolling false, and no registry sources. The 200 response is one series named team/minimum, purpose inference, enabled, with no nodes present. The list shows that series. Opening it shows the saved reference. After reload the detail matches the independent GET, including engine version 1.2.3 inferred from the reference, framework version 12.8, arch multi, rolling false, and no registry sources. The series is catalog metadata with no agent and no workload.
checklist_items.1.3: The community tag list is one small table. Image reference, inference engine, framework, and framework version are the required fields on the community add drawer. With the other three filled, submitting an empty image reference shows the enter-an-image-reference sentence on the image reference field and sends no image import. Submitting a whitespace-only image reference shows the tag sentence on that field and sends no image import. Submitting an empty framework version and submitting a whitespace-only framework version each show the enter-a-framework-version sentence on the framework version field and send no image import. The engine and framework comboboxes are read-only, so a whitespace string cannot be entered. Clearing the engine shows the select-an-inference-engine sentence on the engine field and sends no image import. Clearing the framework shows the select-a-framework sentence on the framework field and sends no image import.
checklist_items.1.9: While the community image import is held the Add Image button stays loading and a second click sends no further import. The later 200 is the only stored series
checklist_items.1.10: The 502 keeps the import drawer and the selected reference, series name, and versions, shows upstream fixture is unreachable, and stores no series. The retry 200 matches the independent detail GET
checklist_items.1.14: After the community import, reloading the images page shows the saved series with one small enable switch, and that switch is on. Opening the series shows the saved image reference. That reloaded detail agrees with the independent series GET, including the reference and enabled true. The series is catalog metadata with no agent and no workload.
checklist_items.12.6: covered: While the community image import is held the Add Image button shows the loading state and a second click sends no further import; the 502 keeps the selected reference, series name, and versions, shows upstream fixture is unreachable, and stores no series; the later 200 matches the independent detail GET and the reloaded link
